title: BOM Validation
description: Validates that JSON files do not contain byte order marks (BOM). BOMs can cause parsing failures in Minecraft.

101.title: BOM Detected
101.description: Error when a JSON file begins with a UTF-8 BOM (byte order mark). Minecraft cannot parse JSON files with BOMs. Re-save the file as UTF-8 without BOM using a text editor.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the file with BOM
